risk: Inadequate electrical service capacity at candidate site
owner: Program owner + electrical engineer of record
trigger_indicator: Service rating/spare capacity unconfirmed at design freeze (currently 12/12 sites unconfirmed)
mitigation: Confirm service rating and spare capacity with Dominion and facility before design freeze; interim: size pilot to worst-case documented capacity with load-management headroom; budget contingency for upgrade only if confirmed necessary
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS rows 1-3; model REVIEW flags; client Crisis Receiving Center capacity limit
residual_risk: Low once confirmed; site dropped or re-scoped if inadequate
deciding_authority: Facility owner + Dominion; final permit call by building official

mitigation: Utility coordination and interconnection review at pilot scale (included in Dominion make-ready process); managed-charging peak cap below agreed threshold (needs real capacity value not placeholder)
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS rows 4-5; EX12 Dominion program review step
residual_risk: Low at 2-3 port pilot scale; rises with expansion

trigger_indicator: Commissioning power-quality check out of tolerance
mitigation: Specify UL 2594-listed EVSE; commissioning power-quality check

risk: Communications outage between chargers and network
trigger_indicator: Comms-loss events in network logs; failed comms test at commissioning
mitigation: Default-safe curtailment profile on comms loss (fail-safe); local fallback schedule for non-networked minimum service
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS rows 7-8; OCPP practice (EX16); proposed-standard Module 5
residual_risk: Medium-low: service degrades to safe default instead of failing

trigger_indicator: Functional test failure; setpoints not honored
mitigation: Hardwired overcurrent protection independent of software (non-negotiable NEC baseline); periodic functional test at commissioning and annually
required_response_time: Immediate (hardware trip); repair per maintenance plan

trigger_indicator: Uptime below contract SLA (NEVI 97% used as benchmark practice not requirement)
mitigation: Uptime SLA in network contract; dual-path monitoring (network + local meter) so downtime is independently visible
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS rows 11-12; FHWA NEVI minimum-standards practice
residual_risk: Medium: some downtime inevitable; trigger data protected

trigger_indicator: Commissioning verification failure; annual inspection finding; responder walkthrough issue
mitigation: Commissioning verification of disconnect location/label/illumination/operation; FD pre-plan walkthrough with Fire Marshal
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS rows 13-14; Adams interview; 12/12 unconfirmed flags; proposed-standard Module 1
required_response_time: Immediate isolation capability required at all times

trigger_indicator: Site is enclosed (only PWC002 Neabsco among 12 candidates)
mitigation: Prefer surface-lot sites for pilots (11/12 are surface); enclosed site held for AHJ review with enhanced conditions
residual_risk: Low if pilot stays on surface lots

risk: Extreme heat / flood / severe weather damage or outage
trigger_indicator: FEMA flood-layer hit or heat-exposure flag in site hazard screen; weather event
mitigation: Site-specific hazard screen (FEMA flood layer heat exposure) before design; equipment environmental rating specification; no resilience claim made (no storage in scope)
residual_risk: Medium: charging unavailable during grid outages by design scope
required_response_time: Screen before design freeze; restoration per event
deciding_authority: Program owner; stormwater authority for drainage

trigger_indicator: Layout not verified against Access Board TA guidance + VA USBC ADA provisions before freeze; Access Board rule status change (still NPRM as of 2026-07-19)
mitigation: ADA-first layout at site screening; design to TA guidance now; track NPRM to final rule and re-check at design time
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS rows 18-19; EX09; client fleet-hub one-year redesign; Dominion same issue (IM-02)
residual_risk: Low if ADA-first; documented one-year schedule cost if ignored
required_response_time: Before design freeze; re-check at each design gate

trigger_indicator: Vendor security assessment finding; PII discovered in site systems
mitigation: Vendor OCPP security profile required; no PII collection on site systems; website/assistant privacy handled separately under VCDPA
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS row 20; transcript privacy concern; Report 10

risk: Stale data driving decisions (grid factors costs code status)
trigger_indicator: Visual or model output lacking source date; annual refresh checklist missed; eGRID vintage older than latest release
mitigation: Dataset refresh dates on all visuals; refresh checklist; grid factor re-pulled annually (current: 596.3 lb CO2e/MWh eGRID2023 Rev 2 per IM-01)
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS row 21; IM-01; repo source-date tracking

risk: Demand forecast error (adoption faster or slower than modeled)
trigger_indicator: Observed utilization diverges from scenario band at any horizon checkpoint
mitigation: Staged deployment itself plus trigger-based expansion - the solution is the mitigation; scenarios carried as bands not point forecasts
evidence_basis: FAILURE_MITIGATION_OPTIONS row 22; core thesis; Neabsco evidence
residual_risk: Low: staging converts forecast error into a timing question
required_response_time: At each trigger review (at least annual)
deciding_authority: City Council / Board of County Supervisors via CIP

trigger_indicator: Utilization below trigger floor for sustained period
mitigation: Expansion only on observed-utilization evidence; equity override so low-adoption areas are not permanently starved; decommissioning plan on file
residual_risk: Low for pilot scale; the risk the staged strategy exists to prevent
deciding_authority: City Council / Board of County Supervisors via CIP

trigger_indicator: Vendor discontinuation notice; part lead time exceeding maintenance window
mitigation: Specify commonly-listed hardware; spare-parts clause in procurement; ~10-year electronics refresh planned

risk: Data/reporting layer failure (loss of trigger evidence)
trigger_indicator: Network vendor outage or contract end without data export
mitigation: Export trigger data to city/county-owned storage monthly; dual-path logging (network + local meter)

trigger_indicator: Trench distance grows at design vs screening assumption; unit-cost quotes above screening band
mitigation: Trenching-distance minimization in site selection (already a model criterion); low/base/high cost cases; 20-30 percent contingency on civil works labeled as class-of-estimate; $429500 12-site figure held as screening value never budget
evidence_basis: Report 09 section 3; McCoart cost-growth client evidence; EX15 ($1k-$10k per connector range driven by trenching/panel/labor)
residual_risk: Medium: civil costs remain the dominant uncertainty until site engineering
deciding_authority: City Council / Board of County Supervisors (budget); program owner (scope)

risk: Funding volatility (federal programs and budget cycles)
trigger_indicator: NEVI guidance or apportionment change; NOFO delay; CIP submission missed; Dominion program queue/eligibility change
mitigation: Dominion Level 2 make-ready program as primary path (50 percent upfront 100 percent for disadvantaged communities - eligibility to confirm); NEVI/CFI treated as upside only with volatility caveat; pilot-only floor as budget-shortfall case (Alternative C degrades gracefully)
evidence_basis: Report 09; EX11 (NEVI freeze then court-ordered release then Aug 2025 interim guidance); IM-06 ($885M FY26 VA solicitations anticipated Q1 2026); IM-07
residual_risk: Medium: no funding is awarded; plan survives on local funds at pilot floor
required_response_time: Per funding-cycle deadlines (Dominion application early; VA NEVI solicitation watch)
deciding_authority: City Council / Board of County Supervisors (appropriation)
